items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Readers, aliases, classifiers, plan/design gates, reference guard, KC8 on reconcile, S0/S2 follow-ups, 12 S3 known-failing entries removed; absence-means-pass inventory and writer-side gates deferred to S4.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Vanished or unreadable drops read as non-ok and block absence; reconcile surfaces only the run's own damaged drop; OverflowError caught.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input surface; folder names compared as exact path components; no shell interpolation.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Fail-closed, negative guard, real ensure_current integration, flat-load subprocess tests; legacy tests unchanged.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Folder scans only when folders exist; legacy-only trees take the old path.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files under 300 lines; touched grandfathered files did not grow (events_read 294).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer record_event drops and consumers (events_read, status regeneration, ensure_current) exercised by the real-producer replay and the integration test.
